items.title: Sportiello interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And people that meant so much to us, like Bucky and Ruth. [INTERVIEWEE] That’s right.

ctx.x: No. I didn’t have to. Just promoters. Even because I’ll say one more time, I was not willing to cancel myself because we still were around so many people including doctors that were saying that this wasn’t a big deal. You know? There were doctors on TV that they were saying that this was just like a common cold or something, not much worse than a seasonal — and so we listened to that and I think maybe we were hoping that that was the case. But then you know speaking of Facebook, a few days ago it was circulating…
And people that meant so much to us, like Bucky and Ruth.
